summary: Intercorp Financial Services Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting that its Board of Directors unanimously approved the 2025 Annual Report on Form 20-F, its filing, and the 2025 audited consolidated financial statements prepared under PCAOB standards. The filing is a routine foreign private issuer report of an annual reporting milestone. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or management change is described. The document simply notifies the SEC of a material event regarding standard annual disclosure. The filing is analogous to a U.S. domestic issuer's Form 10-K filing and does not constitute a special situation.
